description: Empire's route re-found on Napoleon.exe: a larger shadow map (stepped up to 8K), the fit fix and better filtering through runtime engine sites (candidate: shadow light sweep 0xd27696 from J6), each site in engine_sites with anchor bytes, each value a config key. Every step measured against the J23 budget in the 40-unit battle and the largest siege; before and after shots at fixed poses for Liam. This is also the fallback if cascades fail (J25).
title: Shadow map resolution and fit
